summary: ResMed Inc. filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, reporting fiscal Q3 2026 earnings (revenue $1.4B, up 11%; GAAP EPS $2.74) and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.60 per share (record date May 14, payable June 18, 2026). This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement with no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program (beyond ordinary dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing solely covers operational results and a standard dividend declaration, making it a routine current report not qualifying as a special situation.
